independentAssessment.statement: Full exact pinned description/input/output/notes read; all samples match. Original flattened HTML retained separately. Only the two declared exponent spans changed. Fresh public English GET independently matches attested input/output DOM and literal superscripts: n 10^5 and ai 10^9.
independentAssessment.officialRole: 18 of 34 advertised official pairs are available and preserved exactly as supplementary, NOT a complete official suite. All 12 advertised upstream-generated pairs are present; qualification is extensive generated basis.
independentAssessment.generatedDiversity: All 154 authored inputs are distinct; two fresh offline seeded generator runs reproduce both exact pair bytes and recorded output hashes. Independent reviewer derives every supplied answer without trusting generator output or worker recipe.
independentAssessment.derivation: For R rounds assign xi supervisory rounds per person. Feasible iff R>=max(ai) and sum(R-ai)>=R; then nonnegative integer capacities R-ai can hold exactly R supervisory assignments, each yielding n-1 players. Monotone binary search finds first feasible R rather than using worker closed form.
independentAssessment.bruteCrossCheck: Independent BFS over clipped remaining demands, trying every supervisor choice each round, checks all 238 vectors: n=3 with demands1..5; n=4 with demands1..3; n=5 with demands1..2.
independentAssessment.sampleMeanings: (3,2,2) needs four rounds with supervisor counts (1,1,2), giving players (3,3,2). Four demands of2 need three rounds; two rounds only provide six player slots, below eight.
independentAssessment.coverage: 0031 covers minimum n and demands; 0032 dominant demand; 0033 ceiling threshold (3,3,3)->5. 0034 has n=100000 and every ai=1000000000, sum100000000000000 and answer1000010001, covering both maxima and 64-bit accumulation. Official 0013 has two billion-scale demands and answer1005000000; all 150 named adversarial cases independently solved.
independentAssessment.authenticity: Ten counted sources have distinct IDs and source hashes; each exact public pinned TESTS row, programming language and expected verdict is authenticated. The sixth accepted public oracle is disjoint from all ten counted references by both ID and source hash. These are dataset compatibility-adjusted bytes, not a claim of original live Codeforces source bytes.
independentAssessment.algorithmicFailures: Five incorrect sources have independently reviewed substantive numeric errors on unchanged valid LF inputs, exit=0 and timeout=false. Debug-only, newline spelling, compile/runtime, unsupported-runtime and infrastructure failures are not used to qualify.
independentAssessment.sandbox: Fresh workdirs, pinned python image digest, v2 -O2 -std=c++17 -DONLINE_JUDGE; network-none, nonroot, read-only root/payload/harness, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges and bounded CPU/address-space/wall/files/pids/tmpfs. Neither public source nor archived generator runs on the host.
independentAssessment.replay: All 1840 counted per-test verdict/exit/timeout/outputHash tuples match exactly. All ten sources also execute 2 samples, and every accepted source passes them. All sixth-oracle test/sample tuples and both generator hashes/pair lists reproduce exactly.
independentAssessment.priorAuditPreserved: Earlier literal-bound exclusions bind to different package hashes and remain unchanged. Prior 235A/322B/888D exclusions and 383A signoff remain unchanged.
independentAssessment.publication: Only independent content-bound signoff and publication_gate(require_approval=False), not publication. No PR/merge/deploy/database/storage/shared-gate/board mutation.

4593178.reason: Python3 max(a) consumes the map iterator, so supervisory capacity acc remains zero. The subsequent extension divides by n rather than n-1. Valid LF n=3,a=(1,2,100) needs 100 but receives 134; n=3,a=(3,3,3) needs 5 but receives 4. These numeric errors occur with exit=0, not a runtime failure.

4607554.reason: Uses lexicographic string max and always adds one, rather than enforcing total and individual player capacity. LF n=3,a=(1,2,100) receives 3 instead of 100; (3,3,3) receives 4 rather than 5.

5292154.reason: Uses only ceil(sum(a)/(n-1)) and omits the individual lower bound max(a). LF n=3,a=(1,2,100) receives 52 instead of 100.

7285521.reason: Always returns max(a)+1, ignoring total required capacity and cases where max(a) already suffices. LF (1,2,100) receives 101 rather than 100; (3,3,3) receives 4 rather than 5.

7285955.reason: Omits max(a) and adds the entire division remainder instead of a boolean ceil increment. LF (1,2,100) receives 52 rather than 100; sample (2,2,2,2) receives 4 instead of 3.
